UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores public and private profile information for each user. Serves as the primary record.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

interests.description: A list of user's travel interests (e.g., 'hiking', 'foodie'). Max 10.

isVerified.description: Whether the user's identity has been verified by an admin process.

blocked.description: A map of UIDs that this user has blocked. Key is the blocked UID, value is true.

LiveVisibility.title: Live Visibility
LiveVisibility.description: A document that exists ONLY when a user is actively sharing their approximate location. This collection is the core of the geo-queries.

uid.description: The user's ID. Matches the document ID.

isVisible.description: Always true. Queries will filter for this.

visibilityUntil.description: Timestamp when this document becomes invalid and should be ignored/deleted.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last location update.

geohash.description: Full-precision geohash of the user's location.

areaLabel.description: A human-readable label for the area, e.g., 'Connaught Place Area'.

NearbyActivity.title: Nearby Activity
NearbyActivity.description: A user-created, time-limited micro-activity at a specific location.

Report.title: User/Activity Report
Report.description: A report filed by a user against another user or an activity.

targetId.description: The ID of the user or activity being reported.

ConnectRequest.title: Connection Request
ConnectRequest.description: A request from one user to connect with another, typically initiated from the 'Nearby Travellers' screen.
